question.problem: Find the common difference of an arithmetic sequence if its seventh and twenty-second terms are $126$ and $-9$, respectively.
question.worked_solution:
The first thing to note is that the terms are *decreasing*, and therefore we expect $d$ to be *negative*.

We are given the terms

$$
{a}_{7}=126,\,{a}_{22}=-9.
$$

So, to find $d,$ we apply the formula with $n=22$ and $m=7:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =\frac{{a}_{n}-{a}_{m}}{n-m} \\  & =\frac{{a}_{22}-{a}_{7}}{22-7} \\  & =\frac{(-9)-126}{22-7} \\  & =\frac{-135}{15} \\  & =-9\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the common difference is $d=-9.$
